title: Lumen visual refinement · Phase 2
description: Refined native Light and Dark appearance, gesture-driven sidebar and more discoverable chat controls.
notes: Polished conversations, message actions, composer, attachment chips, history search and settings.
Open the sidebar with an edge swipe or handle; close with a left swipe or tap outside.
Search lives in the sidebar header. Archived chats live in the search filters and Settings → Chats & data.
The provider hub is now Router, and temporary chat lives beside New chat in the chat toolbar.
